source.title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
source.source_location: Main-text Eq. 4 and PTO2:Y1 paragraph following Fig. 2f

eta_int.note: Paper reports eta_int=0.06 for PTO2:Y1; no uncertainty is assigned here.
